critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now >3000 lines — strongly recommend extracting compute_salary_v2, applicability_engine, slab_engine into backend/modules/salary_engine/*.py. Readability & unit testability will improve substantially.

SalaryStructurePage.js monolithic (~600+ lines w/ dialogs inline). Consider splitting ComponentDialog, TemplateDialog, SlabBuilder, ApplicabilityBuilder into separate files for reuse & test-id isolation.

Calc type dropdown uses 'percentage_of_group:<GroupName>' string encoding — works but is fragile. Consider calc_type='percentage_of_group' + separate calc_source_group field throughout (UI already does this, but backend also accepts legacy encoding).
Slab engine has no overlap/gap validation — two slabs with overlapping salary_from/to will silently pick the first match. Add server-side validation at component save time.
No uniqueness check on component code across classifications — two components with code='BASIC' (earning + deduction) may cause confusion in percentage_of_club resolution.
(Carried over from iter 9) Payroll Run sync compute >100 employees will time out; consider BackgroundTasks / job polling.
